definitions.explanation: A bat-and-ball sport played between two teams of nine players each, extremely popular in Japan.

examples.japanese: {野球|やきゅう}が{好|す}きです。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}、{毎日|まいにち}{野球|やきゅう}をしていた。
examples.english: When I was a child, I played baseball every day.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}{野球|やきゅう}の{甲子園|こうしえん}{大会|たいかい}は{夏|なつ}の{風物詩|ふうぶつし}だ。
examples.english: The Koshien high school baseball tournament is a summer tradition.

notes:
{野球|やきゅう} is one of the most popular sports in Japan. Professional baseball ({プロ野球|ぷろやきゅう}) has 12 teams divided into two leagues. High school baseball, particularly the {甲子園|こうしえん} tournament, enjoys immense popularity.

Common expressions:
- {野球|やきゅう}をする (to play baseball)
- {野球|やきゅう}を{見|み}る (to watch baseball)
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ} (baseball club)
- {野球場|やきゅうじょう} (baseball stadium)
